ideas.title: The Impact of Medicaid Fraud on Patients and Providers
ideas.description: This story would investigate the effects of Medicaid fraud on patients and providers in Minnesota.
ideas.angle: The human impact of Medicaid fraud
questions: How does Medicaid fraud affect patients?
What are the consequences for providers?
ideas.insight: This story could shed light on the consequences of Medicaid fraud and the importance of preventing it.
